name: Ash-throated Antwren
rangeDescription: East slope of andes of north-central peru (san martín)
description: Rare antwren restricted to a small area of the eastern Andes in northern Peru. Note the black cap, striped face, white wingbars, and lack of rufous in the wing.

name: Ticking Doradito
rangeDescription: Breeds central chile, and western argentina; winters northward to bolivia
description: Very local little bird of fresh and brackish marshes and adjacent weedy vegetation in lowlands. Departs Chile in the winter (mainly late March to mid-October) for unknown areas east of the Andes.

name: Long-tufted Screech-Owl
rangeDescription: Foothills of southeastern brazil, uruguay, and northeastern argentina (misiones)
description: Medium-sized screech-owl, very similar to Black-capped Screech Owl, but smaller and their ranges marginally overlap. Occurs in both brown and rufous morphs, both with yellow eyes.

name: White-cheeked Tit
rangeDescription: Juniper and ilex scrub of western kashmir, afghanistan, and northern pakistan
description: A tiny bird with a large head, a short bill, and a long tail. Similar in shape to other long-tailed tits, but note the unique combination of black throat, brown crown, and black eye-mask.

name: Campina Thrush
rangeDescription: Eastern colombia eastward to southern venezuela and guyana, southward locally to central amazonian brazil, from the east bank of the río madeira to the east bank of the río tapajós
description: A drab thrush, uncommon in open habitats and woodlands in the lowlands. Nondescript grayish-brown with a pale whitish belly.

name: Western Red-billed Hornbill
rangeDescription: Senegambia to (mali) inner niger delta
description: Fairly small, slim, long-tailed hornbill. Note the red bill, dark eye with a ring of black skin, and heavily spotted back.

name: Black-eared Cuckoo
rangeDescription: Australia
description: Small plain cuckoo with a dark eye and black

name: Saipan Reed Warbler
rangeDescription: Saipan and alamagan (northern mariana islands)
description: A relatively large plain brown reed warbler with a pale throat, a yellowish face, a darker cap and tail, and an absurdly long decurved bill. Found in areas of tall dense grasses, reed marshes, and scrubby thickets up to 400 meters of elevation.

name: Cambodian Flowerpecker
rangeDescription: Mountains of eastern thailand and cambodia
description: Range-restricted flowerpecker of the Cardamom Mountains in southwestern Cambodia and far eastern Thailand. Adult male is dark blue above and pale creamy white below, with a black stripe down the center of the belly.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Itatiaia Spinetail
rangeDescription: High mountains of southeastern brazil (southern espírito santo to northeastern são paulo)
description: Small, plain, long-billed and long-tailed spinetail with a restricted range. Found in bamboo thickets and clearings in montane forests with grass and shrubs where it forages in the understory.

name: Ferruginous Hawk
rangeDescription: Prairies and plains of southern canada to northern mexico
description: Large raptor of dry open country; light morph much more common than dark morph. Light adult distinctly rufous above with blue-gray flight feathers, white breast, and rufous barring on sides.

name: Gray Bunting
rangeDescription: Southern kamchatka, sakhalin, kuril islands, and northern japan; winters to ryukyu islands (southern japan)
description: Small songbird of shady undergrowth, especially dwarf bamboo thickets, found in mid-elevation coniferous or deciduous forests during summer and in shady woodlands and parks during winter. Male uniquely slate-gray; both sexes have warm, rufous-brown rump and tail.

name: Indochinese Roller
rangeDescription: Northeastern india to south-central china, northern malay peninsula, and indochina
description: A brightly colored bird with various shades of blue on the wings, tails, and belly that are often more prominent in flight. Similar to Indian Roller but has a purple-blue breast, a darker olive back, and is generally darker blue.

name: Small Blue Kingfisher
rangeDescription: Southern sumatra, java, bali, lombok, sumbawa, and kangean islands
description: Tiny sky-blue kingfisher with a snowy-white throat, belly, and facial patches. Male averages bluer than female, which has a greenish cast.

name: Blue-throated Macaw
rangeDescription: Northern bolivia (llanos de moxos, beni)
description: Large macaw endemic to flooded grasslands of El Beni, Bolivia (Llanos de Moxos). Breeds in cavities in tall palms, and threatened by habitat loss.

name: Sinaloa Crow
rangeDescription: Coastal lowlands of western mexico (southern sonora to western nayarit)
description: Small glossy crow, common in northwest Mexico; endemic. Occurs in towns, villages, rubbish dumps, farmland, and semiopen areas with hedges and taller trees; often near water.

name: Kuhl's Lorikeet
rangeDescription: Northern line islands (rimitara, kiritimati, tabuaeran, and teraina)
description: Luminous, short-tailed parrot with a cherry-red throat and breast, green upperparts, and finely hooked orange bill. Also note the spiky feathers making up the green-and-blue crown.

name: Omani Owl
rangeDescription: Distribution poorly known; documented from northeastern united arab emirates, northern oman, northeastern iran, and southwestern pakistan
description: Pale, medium-sized owl of dry rocky country with cliffs and canyons. Dark brown above and pale with narrow dark streaks below.

name: Red-throated Thrush
rangeDescription: Eastern siberia to northern manchuria; winters to western china, myanmar, and northeastern india
description: This eastern counterpart of the Black-throated Thrush also breeds in montane areas and winters in lower-elevation areas on average. Males gray above and white below, with a brick-red throat and supercilium.

name: Pied Coucal
rangeDescription: New ireland and new britain (eastern bismarck archipelago)
description: A long-tailed, thick-billed, uniquely patterned bird with dark blue wings, tail, and belly and creamy neck, chest, and head. Note the obvious dark cap and mask.
